description: This file manages profile picture storage, including IndexedDB initialization, retrieval, saving, deletion, image optimization, validation, and conversion to base64.

methods.name: initDB
methods.description: Initializes the IndexedDB database for profile pictures.

methods.name: getProfilePictureFromDB
methods.description: Retrieves the profile picture from IndexedDB, returning the stored image or the original if not stored locally.

methods.name: saveProfilePictureInDB
methods.description: Saves a base64 image string into IndexedDB and returns a local file key with a UUID.

methods.name: deleteProfilePictureFromDB
methods.description: Deletes and recreates the IndexedDB to reset profile picture storage.

methods.name: optimizeProfilePicture
methods.description: Crops and scales an image file to a centered square with device pixel ratio considerations.

methods.name: validateImageFile
methods.description: Validates image file type and size against allowed formats and maximum size.

methods.name: fileToBase64
methods.description: Converts a File object to a base64 string.
